summary: Separate a convenient address model from physical data placement and explain page movement under memory pressure.
outcomes: Distinguish unified virtual addressing, managed memory and actual coherence.
Diagnose migration and oversubscription costs from a trace.
sequence: Track one allocation by address and physical location.
Compare explicit copies with managed page movement.

visual.question: Where is this page when the next operation touches it?

practice.success: Results are correct; memory pressure and migration evidence explain the performance difference.
